structured.answer: I'd pick option 3, the table with all the companies in rows ("כל החברות מול כל סוגי ההשקעה"). Each company is one line with its fees, so I can see straight away who takes more, Mor about 0.7% and Harel about 0.55%. I'd still ask my son or the bank before moving money.
